description: Inspect public sales and runs, join an auction, bid or negotiate, and recover exact decisions. Use offer/respond for conversation-based negotiation and sell for private drafts. Secret reads accept input.share_token from the exact link; this grants viewing only. Publish/create_run accept input.secret; run configure accepts command.secret/rotate_share_link/expected_visibility_revision. Public reads are free; approved writes can incur the returned SBZ fees, bind the person and notify participants. Seller and organiser actions require approved seller status. Supply the exact sale/run, terms, pricing and input.requestId; recover or retry that same ID after uncertainty. confirm_handover records actual handover for either recorded participant. It returns native state, events or a decision receipt with billing.

0.description: Exact buyer profile for an authorised seller proposal.

action.description: Choose the operation; supply only its applicable fields. discover: search current public sales; runs: list public auction runs; inspect_run: read one exact run; run_events: read its ordered events; listing: resolve a stable listing to its public sale; buying: your buyer conversations or activity; inspect: read one exact record; events: read ordered public sale events; offers: read your permitted offers; activity: read your native trading activity; recover: recover the original native request receipt; withdraw_consent: retired sale-contact action; succeeds without changing trading authority; join: approve admission to this run; leave: leave this run and cancel its maxima; execute: submit one exact native command; confirm_handover: record actual handover without asserting payment.

input.description: Arguments for the selected operation; the server validates its exact required fields.

acceptTerms.description: Retired trading field; accepted and ignored for older clients.

attribution.description: Original first-touch campaign values; never trading authority.

captured_at.description: Original capture time in ISO 8601 UTC.

channel.description: Original acquisition channel. browser: website acquisition; mcp: connected-client acquisition.

command.description: One exact native mutation; all other arguments must match that command.

amount.description: Exact decimal amount in the selected offer currency or frozen listing currency, never a floating-point number.

bidId.description: Exact accepted bid identity to retract under its rules.

currency.description: Exact currency symbol/descriptor returned by the listing or offer; do not convert the native amount.

kind.description: Select the record, decision or variant described by this container. bid: place an explicit live bid; set_maximum: save an authorised bidding ceiling; cancel_maximum: cancel your saved ceiling; retract_bid: retract the exact eligible bid; make_offer: send a binding proposal; counter_offer: replace the exact proposal with a counter; accept_offer: bind the exact current proposal; decline_offer: refuse that proposal; withdraw_offer: remove your own current proposal.

note.description: Optional private offer note; not separate trading authority.

offerHash.description: SHA-256 of that exact offer; binds price and participants.

offerId.description: Exact current offer identity returned by the thread.

reason.description: Explicit explanation for this requested action; never infer consent from it.

confirmed.description: True only after the recorded participant confirms actual handover. true: explicitly approve the stated condition.

contactConsent.description: Retired field; accepted and ignored for older clients.

cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor from this exact query; omit for the first page.

expectedParticipationRevision.description: Exact membership revision returned by inspect_run; required after membership changes.

joined.description: When true, return only this account’s joined runs.

limit.description: Maximum page size; omit for the operation’s default. Default 64. Maximum 512.

listingId.description: Stable listing UUID, independent of publication identity. UUID.

maxFeeSBZ.description: Optional approved service fee ceiling as a whole SBZ string; never the item price.

phase.description: Sale lifecycle to discover; omit for actionable current items. scheduled: not yet open; open: currently open to participation; reserved: a recorded buyer holds the item; sold: sale recorded as completed; unsold: closed without a completed sale; withdrawn: withdrawn from public trading.

pricing.description: Exact published fee schedule reference approved for this action.

revision.description: Exact published revision; copy it rather than predicting the next value.

sha256.description: SHA-256 digest of the exact returned content or authority.

version.description: Exact published document or pricing version; copy it from the preceding read.

query.description: Text search without an explicit phase returns only cards open to offers and auctions whose bidding deadline has not passed. Supply phase for explicit historical or scheduled discovery.

requestId.description: UUID for one native trading request; recover or retry the same instructions after uncertainty. UUID.

runId.description: Exact auction run identity; membership never transfers to another run.

saleId.description: Exact sale identity returned by discovery or the conversation.

scopeId.description: Exact sale/run scope identity from the public record.

section.description: Subset of buying or selling activity. active: currently active records; maxima: your saved bidding ceilings; offers: read your permitted offers; won: your recorded wins; closed: terminal activity.

sellerId.description: Exact seller profile identity for discovery.

share_token.description: Unguessable token from the exact secret share link. It grants viewing only; normal account, participation and trading requirements still apply.

termsHash.description: SHA-256 of the exact sale terms the person approved.

name: trade

0.description: Effective link-only visibility, including a secret parent event. Independent of lifecycle and frozen terms.

1.description: Owner only: this listing or event’s own setting.

2.description: Owner only: a secret parent event prevents making this listing public.

3.description: Owner only: optimistic revision required for visibility changes and link rotation.

4.description: Owner only, when effectively secret: absolute unguessable share URL. Never returned to a non-owner or inside another object’s catalogue.

billing.description: charged, assessed, balance and available_credits are whole SBZ strings or null; receipt_id identifies the saved fee. Replays never charge twice.

committed_stages.description: Stages already committed before a later refusal; retain their receipts.

data.description: Native sale/run/listing IDs, public native prices, events, participation and exact decision receipts. Owner visibility fields are at the data root on inspect/inspect_run/listing, in each owned item on selling, and in visibility after publish/create_run or visibility-changing run configure. IDs are exact returned identifiers (UUID where declared); prices retain amount/currency (123 USD); times use ISO 8601 UTC; cursors are opaque.

error.description: Optional business error: code, message, HTTP status, retryable and recovery details.

next.description: Exactly one required continuation: call, input, approval, choice, wait or done. It never grants new consent.

pagination.description: Optional next-page call; not required work or consent.

retry.description: Optional exact request_id and permitted recovery call.

state.description: Outcome: finished, still processing, needs approval/input, or refused.

summary.description: Plain-language result, including a business error.

title: Inspect and participate in sales
